typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		unique_customer_id as string,
		TouchpointId as string,
		Touchpoint_Type as string,
		Agent_UID as string,
		Call_Start_Time as string,
		Call_End_Time as string,
		Call_Reason as string,
		Ani as string,
		DNIS as string,
		client_assigned_customer_id as string,
		Medical_Record_Number as string,
		first_name as string,
		middle_initial as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		BirthDate as string,
		Age as string,
		Gender as string,
		Married as string,
		Address1 as string,
		Address2 as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip_plus_4 as string,
		Mailing_Address1 as string,
		Mailing_Address2 as string,
		Mailing_City as string,
		Mailing_State as string,
		Mailing_Zip_plus_4 as string,
		Spouse_First_Name as string,
		Spouse_Middle_Initial as string,
		Spouse_Last_Name as string,
		Spouse_DOB as string,
		Spouse_Age as string,
		Spouse_Gender as string,
		Dependent_First_Name as string,
		Dependent_Middle_Initial as string,
		Dependent_Last_Name as string,
		Dependent_DOB as string,
		Dependent_Age as string,
		Dependent_Gender as string,
		Work_Phone as string,
		Mobile_Phone as string,
		Home_Phone as string,
		Other_Phone as string,
		Fax as string,
		Email as string,
		Best_Time as string,
		Best_Phone as string,
		Household_Size as string,
		Household_Income as string,
		Children as string,
		Occupation as string,
		Insured as string,
		HIPPA_Auth as string,
		Referral_Information__c as string,
		Do_Not_Call as string,
		Do_Not_Email as string,
		SMS_Opt_in as string,
		Do_Not_Solicit as string,
		Contact_Type as string,
		Primary_Contact_UID as string,
		Do_Not_Mail as string,
		Language_Preference as string,
		Score_Urgency as string,
		Score_Medical as string,
		Score_Lead as string,
		Small_Business_Indicator as string,
		Primary_Address_Change as string,
		Mailing_Address_Change as string,
		Name_Change as string,
		Deceased_Flag as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['salesforce/customerconnect*']) ~> TaskContact
source(output(
		Id as string,
		Name as string,
		Division as string,
		Extension as string,
		NUID__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['User/*']) ~> User
TaskContact, Select1 join(Agent_UID == Id,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join1
User select(mapColumn(
		Id,
		Name,
		Division,
		Extension
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Join1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('customerconnect_', toString(currentUTC(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'), '.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toExport
